memoryProtocol: MLX allocation high-water mark reset after warmup, measured across transcription; includes held model allocations, excludes untracked Python/native memory. Not total process or system RAM.

parameters.timingScope: accelerated direct Session.handle + MLX synchronization; excludes model load, IPC, packet encoding, scoring and inter-clip reset

native.finish: close; one step then at most finalStepLimit additional steps until done; fail if not done
native.retention: retire consumed adapter frames and PCM; clear generated/_prev_text each step; retain native rotating KV and positions
native.text: incremental token_bytes UTF-8 decoder; hold incomplete byte sequences until safe; flush final remainder

note: Measured during this completed two-pass timing run, not a separate one-pass memory profile.
